propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json off disk as an offline Jira oracle and relies on its field values for drift classification.
Narrowing prev_snapshot to a key-set (empty dict entries) would silently degrade bridge_fsck's field-based drift classification without any reconcile_once test catching it.
Classification should use membership where sufficient and report indeterminate when a field value is genuinely required, never inferring absent values from empty dicts.
Against a key-set prev fixture, classification must match the full-payload fixture for non-field cases and report indeterminate (never false drift) otherwise.
Against a full-payload prev, behaviour must remain byte-identical to today with no regression.
The rebar bridge-fsck CLI exit code and JSON shape must be unchanged for both fixtures.
